name: Rune Giant
source: Bestiary 2, Pathfinder No. 6: Spires of Xin-Shalast

speed.notes: 35 ft.,  50 ft. without armor, other_semicolon air walk ft.

skills.text: Acrobatics +15, Craft (any one) +25, Knowledge (history) +12, Knowledge (nobility) +12, Perception +29

description: This giant’s skin is black and pitted, like roughly cast iron, and etched with glowing red runes.

ecology.name: Organisation
ecology.desc: solitary, pair, patrol (3-6), squad (7-12), or company (13-30 plus 2-4 fighters or rogues of 2nd-4th level, 1 oracle or sorcerer of 5th-8th level, 1 ranger or monk commander of 5th-6th level, 10-20 yetis, 1-4 cloud giants, 8-12 frost giants, 10-16 stone giants, 4-8 lamia matriarchs, and 1-2 adult blue dragons)

ecology.name: Treasure
ecology.desc: standard (masterwork full plate armor, masterwork longsword, 3 masterwork spears, other treasure)
